# AgentNeuron

> AgentNeuron (npm package `agentneuron`) is an open-source, MIT-licensed Node.js CLI, local web dashboard and read-only MCP server that monitors, lints and manages AI coding-agent context files: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, Cursor rules, GitHub Copilot instructions, Windsurf rules, skills, subagents and MCP configs.

Key facts:

- Run: `npx agentneuron [dir]`, then open http://127.0.0.1:4747. Requires Node.js 18+. Also available as a global install (`npm i -g agentneuron`), a single-file bundle (`node agentneuron.mjs`) and a Docker image (`ghcr.io/turjoat/agentneuron`).
- Local only: binds to 127.0.0.1, no telemetry, no account, does not call any AI model. Token counts are local estimates.
- Read-only by default; writes only inside `<project>/.agentneuron/`. Editing files and running commands require explicit permission levels (`edit`, `exec`, `danger`, `terminal`) via `--enable` or `.agentneuron/config.json`.
- Features: live change feed and per-file history, health score from 8 lint rules (broken links and @imports, missing paths, secrets, large context, duplicate rules, stale plans, orphans, empty files), link graph, effective context per folder for Claude/Codex/Cursor, Agents center covering 13 AI tools with sync and drift between instruction files, tasks from Markdown checkboxes, git views, project intelligence, reports with CSV/Markdown/HTML/JSON export and an AI context pack, workspace mode for many projects. Since 1.0.0: Live view of files Claude Code and Codex edit in real time, truth check of instructions against the repo (`agentneuron verify`), agent-config security audit (`agentneuron audit`), context CI with a GitHub Action (`agentneuron ci`), lessons and rule effectiveness from agent sessions (`agentneuron lessons`), a rules compiler that writes every tool's files from one source (`agentneuron compile`), cited AGENTS.md generation (`agentneuron generate`), and multi-agent coordination (claims, handoffs). Usage analytics (`agentneuron usage`, Usage & cost and Sessions pages): cost per day/model/branch/session from local Claude Code and Codex logs (exact where Claude Code recorded it, otherwise estimated), cache hit rate and savings, tool error rates and failure loops, step-by-step session replay with file diffs, subagent fleet graphs, prompt library, code impact, activity patterns, and Claude memory and plans checked against the repo. Quality tools: Ship check (`agentneuron ship`: runs tests/build/lint on request, verdict with evidence, acceptance criteria per task, production-readiness and fake-functionality scans), Change review (`agentneuron review`: risk-rated diff, impact analysis; `agentneuron checkpoint`: safe restore points as git refs with per-file restore; `agentneuron packages`: look-alike or risky dependencies), and Agent brief (`agentneuron resume` briefs to continue in another agent, `agentneuron preflight` warnings that exit 2 for Claude Code hooks, `agentneuron pack` task context packs, `agentneuron debug` error diagnosis).
- CI: `npx agentneuron ci` (or the GitHub Action `TurjoAt/agentneuron@v1.0.0`) runs lint, truth check and security audit and annotates pull requests.
- MCP: `npx -y agentneuron mcp [dir]` on stdio; read-only tools `project_info`, `list_files`, `read_file`, `search`, `get_health`, `get_context`, `recent_changes`, `get_tasks`, `get_links`, `report_export`, `verify_context`, `audit_agent_config`, `suggest_rules`, `compile_preview`, `get_usage`, `get_session_replay`, `get_tool_health`, `get_ship_report`, `get_task_scope`, `review_changes`, `get_change_impact`, `check_package`, `get_resume_brief`, `preflight_check`, `get_context_pack`, `get_debug_report`, `list_claims`, `get_handoffs`; with `--level state` also `claim_task`, `claim_files`, `release_files`, `handoff_note`.
- Author: Rezaul Hoque Turjo (https://turjo.me). Repository: https://github.com/TurjoAt/agentneuron

- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TurjoAt/agentneuron/main/docs/mcp.md): tools and client configuration for Claude Code, Cursor and others
- [Supported tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TurjoAt/agentneuron/main/docs/supported-tools.md): file patterns detected per AI tool, sync targets, templates

- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TurjoAt/agentneuron/main/docs/faq.md): short answers to common questions
